# AMZ FullExplorer - Complete Technical Specification (LLMs Full)

> In-depth technical architecture, SQLite Triples schema, daemon synchronizer loop, and query API reference for the AMZ FullExplorer service by Amazonic One.

---

## 1. System Overview

AMZ FullExplorer (`https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com`) operates as a local or remote caching and indexing layer positioned directly in front of AMZ validation nodes (`https://nodes.amzexplorer.com/`).

### Performance Objectives
- Sub-millisecond indexed searches across millions of transactions, blocks, and account balances.
- Minimal RAM footprint (<1GB) with WAL-mode SQLite database storage.
- Real-time synchronization with microblocks, avoiding deep RPC latency on node state queries.
- Support for token precision up to 18 decimals and REDD+ high-integrity carbon credit assets.

---

## 2. Relational Triples Schema & Database Architecture

The SQLite database (`blockchain.sqlite3`) uses indexed numeric IDs mapped to strings (addresses, aliases, function calls, assets):

### Tables
1. **`pts` (Points/Relations)**: Core relational ledger table linking entities, transaction types, blocks, and timestamps.
2. **`ts` (Transactions)**: Maps numeric internal transaction keys (`r0`) to Base58 transaction IDs partitioned into 8-byte buckets (`r1`, `r2`).
3. **`data`**: Key-value pairs stored on-chain via Data Transactions (Type 12) for smart contract state and carbon credits registry.
4. **`balances`**: Materialized circulating balances per address and asset identifier.

---

## 3. URL Router & HTTP Access Rules

The FullExplorer router parses request URIs into structured route dispatches:

- `/`: Generator telemetry overview.
- `/b/{height}`: Renders block payload at the given integer height.
- `/tx/{txId}`: Renders transaction details. Hashes >36 characters automatically route to transaction view.
- `/{address}`: Renders address transaction history, token balances, and account data entries.
- `/GENERATORS`: Real-time block production metrics for all validator nodes.
- `/top`: Circulating balance leaderboard (Rich List).
- `/ACTIVATION`: Network consensus voting progress for protocol features.
- `/api`: Programmatic JSON/text endpoint for client applications.
- `/sitemap.xml`: XML sitemap index.
- `/llms.txt`: Summary AISEO context.
- `/llms-full.txt`: This full reference document.

---

## 4. API Endpoints

The FullExplorer API at `/api` handles compressed or plaintext queries:
- Query transactions: returns formatted transaction HTML/JSON slices.
- Query address data: returns current key-values from SQLite `data` table.
- Query generator statistics: returns validator rewards and generation shares.
